# Jarvis.ceo Task Architecture and Open-Source Integration

## Jarvis.ceo Task Architecture and Open-Source Integration
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/akshayaggarwal99/jarvis-ai-assistant/bec50ef6e615707613c4fa22c8bd6afc3cc93152/README.md

- 文档说明（raw L92–L96，依据 L92–L92）Jarvis.ceo supports local LLMs via Ollama, allowing users to run models like LFM2 and Llama 3 locally for fast, private processing.
- 文档说明（raw L38–L45，依据 L40–L43）Jarvis.ceo provides keyboard shortcuts for voice dictation, such as holding \`Fn\` to start/stop recording and double-tapping \`Fn\` to toggle hands-free mode.
- 文档说明（raw L92–L98，依据 L94–L94）The unified-agent.ts file processes user queries using function calling to determine if a tool should be used, with fallback to text generation for providers without tool support.

## Code Implementation and Integration
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/akshayaggarwal99/jarvis-ai-assistant/bec50ef6e615707613c4fa22c8bd6afc3cc93152/src/core/agent-manager.ts

- 该处标注（raw L36–L43，依据 L39–L39）The AgentManager class in agent-manager.ts initializes the agent with support for Ollama, with plans to add OpenAI and Gemini providers in the future.
- 该处标注（raw L36–L43，依据 L39–L39）The unified-agent.ts file logs detailed information about the provider and tools used, including the initialization of the agent and processing of user queries.
- 该处标注（raw L36–L43，依据 L39–L39）The OpenJarvis/native\_react.py file includes functionality for handling text and message processing, with support for features like text stripping and message insertion.

- 代码观察（raw L25–L29，依据 L25–L25）Logger.info() is used extensively in the unified-agent.ts file to log information about the agent's operations, including initialization and query processing.
